arguments.message:
Sure! To point a custom domain at your Meridian support portal you need two DNS records added at your DNS provider:
1. **CNAME** – points the subdomain you want to use (e.g., support.yourcompany.com) to Meridian’s portal address.
2. **TXT** – used to verify that you own the domain before the custom domain is activated.
Both records are created outside of Meridian (in your DNS host), and after they’re added the verification runs automatically (it may take up to your DNS provider’s propagation time).
